architecture.image: Immutable image identity, digest, dependency lock and sanitized boot attestation required; no ubuntu-latest assumption
architecture.permissions: Ephemeral least-privilege identity; no repository write token or inherited cloud credentials; separation of control plane from diagnostic process
architecture.egress: Independent upstream default-deny before workload starts, IPv4/IPv6 UDP/TCP, proxy and encrypted DNS bypass included
architecture.dns: Separately measure resolver calls, QNAME/QTYPE questions and client-egress transmissions; per-unit budget remains UNSET
architecture.quota: Deny before next outbound operation; atomic policy and counter; counter failure aborts
architecture.privacy: Sanitize in-memory, allowlist-only diagnostic metadata; no raw URL, token, packet, IP, secret or speech output
architecture.evidence: Signed and independently reviewed configuration and effectiveness evidence required prior to future owner decision
